name: Standing Reset
description: Seven easy moves done on your feet, using only a little space beside your desk.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A short standing routine that fits in the space beside your desk, shown on Movement Routine.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Stand up, move a little and head back when you like.
howToPlay: Stand with your feet about hip width apart and read the move.
Press Start timer for timed moves, or take your time with moves counted in times.
Press Next for the following move, or Skip to leave one out.
tips: General ideas for a break, not advice. If standing does not suit you today, most moves also work with a hand on the desk or chair. Skip any that do not suit you.
